title: UPSSSC Lekhpal Mains Result 2026 – Out
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: UPSSSC Lekhpal recruitment 2025-26 with 7994 posts in Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission.
qualification: Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) from any recognized board in India.
ageLimit: Minimum age 18 years, maximum age 40 years as on 01 July 2025. UPSSSC age relaxation rules apply.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS : ₹25/-, SC / ST : ₹25/-, PH : ₹25/-. Payment through debit card, credit card, internet banking, IMPS, cash card or mobile wallet.
documentsRequired: Registration details, result details, valid photo ID, and original eligibility documents for verification.
howToApply:
1. Visit UPSSSC official website
2. Login through Candidate Login or Important Notices
3. Download the result or answer key from the official portal
4. Verify all details and take a printout
shortDescription: UPSSSC Lekhpal Mains Result 2026 is released. Check the result, cutoff and answer key from the official UPSSSC website.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Lekhpal Mains Result 2026 on the official website.

The examination was held on 21 May 2026, while the last date to submit the application and fee payment was 28 January 2026. The result is now available on the UPSSSC portal and candidates can also download the official result from the direct result link.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date: 29 December 2025
  • Online Apply Last Date: 28 January 2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 28 January 2026
  • Correction Date: 04 February 2026
  • Eligibility Result: 26 February 2026
  • Exam Date: 21 May 2026
  • Exam City Details: 11 May 2026
  • Admit Card: 16 May 2026
  • Answer Key: 22 May 2026
  • Revised Answer Key: 01 July 2026
  • Result Date: 11 September 2026

Use the direct result, cutoff and answer key links below to download the required documents from UPSSSC’s official domain and official Sarkari Result sources.
